name: Abyssal 1
description: Plongeur des abysses récupérant les artefacts engloutis des stations submergées lors des grandes inondations.

loadout.armor_outfit: Peaux bleutées avec motifs bioluminescents. Armures de corail vivant. Cheveux flottant comme des algues. Yeux larges adaptés à la basse lumière.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's death ability (self_on_flip) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Everyday working pose, natural stance — character shown in their normal operational state — Death transformation — body shifting on being captured, power released in final burst

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

scenography.setting: Underwater organic colony in a nebulous aquatic environment, flowing crystalline growths interwoven with living coral, bioluminescent pathways connecting pod-like habitats
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Swirling bioluminescent particles, gentle water currents visible through light refraction, translucent membrane structures pulsing with inner glow, plus final sacrifice — dramatic release of accumulated energy at the moment of defeat visible in the environment

card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Exode Pélagique est une migration massive de peuples aquatiques fuyant la destruction de leurs océans. Ils construisent des cités flottantes dans les nébuleuses aqueuses.
